Hi all —

Adding the marketplace playbook so Priyanka has the exact steps per cloud. Summary:

AWS Marketplace (most common for Nebula):
- Buyer issues PO to Redwood? If buyer prefers AWS billing, AP pays AWS and AWS remits to Redwood. For that flow we need: buyer account email + marketplace Buyer Organization ID.
- If buyer wants Redwood invoice directly, we must opt-out of AWS-managed billing for that listing (requires a seller-side opt-out request and legal acceptance).

GCP Marketplace:
- Requires the buyer to add Redwood as a partner in the Billing Account UI or use a payor mapping flow. Nebula's billing admin will need to add our Seller ID to their billing account.
- GCP often requires an additional payor entity sheet from our side — see attached quick guide.

Azure Marketplace:
- Azure vendor setup can route via Microsoft or direct invoicing; there is a shorter latency for activation via Microsoft-managed billing.

Practical recommendation: If Nebula wants the fastest path to provisioning (minimal paperwork) use the marketplace-managed billing (AWS/GCP) route — AP will pay the cloud provider and we avoid direct invoicing delays. If Nebula needs vendor invoices for accounting reasons, we'll proceed with direct invoice onboarding (requires tax docs + vendor profile update).

I've attached a short integration guide that shows the exact fields AP will need and the Seller Center links.

Kimberly Park
Marketplace Onboarding — Redwood Inference

Priyanka —

A couple of billing clarifications from finance:
- PO number format: we accept PO IDs formatted as "NEB-#####" or standard numeric PO. Please include the PO on the invoice PDF and in the invoice metadata when uploading to the marketplace.
- Payment terms: Redwood standard is Net30 for direct invoicing. Marketplace-managed billing follows the cloud provider's payment terms.
- For any SLA exception requests (for example, non-standard uptime SLA or early termination credits) please complete the attached SLA exception form and we'll route to Sales Ops.

If Nebula requires our invoices to route to a specific remit address or have alternate payor entity on the invoice, please provide the remit details now so we can preconfigure profiles.

Vanessa Ortiz
